Emberfall Wiki

Emberfall is an original mobile idle RPG prototype: collectible heroes, automatic 3v3 (soon 5v5) turn-based combat, campaign progression, summoning, idle income, local saving. Built in Unity 6.5 on the Built-In Render Pipeline (not URP), portrait, touch-first, targeting Android. Combat is a pure function — CombatSimulation.Run() resolves an entire fight up front into a list of BattleEvents, and the battle screen only plays that list back; it never computes damage or picks targets. Content (heroes, enemies, campaign, balance) lives in JSON under Assets/Resources/Content, not in code.

This wiki is a condensed reference distilled from the DESIGN-*.md documents and the current code and content, for the solo dev and a designer friend who don't want to re-read five long docs to remember how something works. It is not a replacement for those docs — where something needs the full argument, the page says so and points at the source.

Pages

  • The World — the fiction: the six beliefs, the First Light, the Cinder and the Keeper, the six regions.
  • Aspects — what each of the six aspects actually does mechanically, which heroes fit their aspect and which don't, and what's implemented vs. still proposed.
  • Combat Systems — the damage pipeline, Effect Hit/Resist, Defence — clearly split into what's live in code today vs. what's still a proposal.
  • Heroes — the six current heroes, their kits, and how each squares with its aspect.
  • Open Questions — everything flagged as undecided, parked, or needing a human across all the design docs, grouped by topic.
  • Glossary — every StatusKind, PassiveTrigger, and EffectKind in the game, one line each.
